page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan. Left page: running text in two columns with a small section below; a short heading "CAP. X." and title "De Imposturis Sophismatum." below the first column area. Right page: running text in two columns, with notes in the margins. Left page first, then right page.

main_text.p: pste 6. & Cotonus in Epistolis ad Chamierum malunt loqui de patribus. Fronto Ducæus in Catalogo errorum Plessei capite 4. refert ad ipsam maxiriam, qua crux constat, Nazianzenus dicit sororem suam seruasse apud corporis & sanguinis Christi: Hunc Bellarminus de Eucharistia libro 4. cap. 24. contendit loqui de specie panis, non vini. Quasi vnum antitypum, sit multa antitypa: & panis posset appellari antitypum sanguinis.
main_text.head: CAP. X.
De Imposturis Sophismatum.
main_text.p: I. Atque hæc de Papistarum fide in cirandis testibus. Nunc de vitiis in ratiocinando.
II. Ordines duo. Priot; quum quod figuratum est, sumitur. Caeundum est (inquit Augustinus de Doctrina Christiana lib. 3. ca.) nefiguratum loquutionum adlteram ace pias.
VI. Hactenus Transeo ad Sophisma. Cap. 1. posterioris Priori. Dabo autem operam & frequenter habere vos post obitum meum, vt horum memoriam faciatis.
V. Culuum Mariæ Bozius acutissime probat. Primo ex Numerorum 24.

page.notes: Two pages of Latin with Greek passages; several Greek phrases and marginal references are only partly legible and are approximated. Right margin notes not fully legible; lines in the second column of the right page are partly illegible due to scan quality.
